observations: Console features Uncharted 4 Limited Edition grey-blue finish with Nathan Drake graphic and 'UNCHARTED' text.
Console is wrapped in protective plastic film.
One boxed DualShock 4 wireless controller in a light blue/green color.
TV screen displays a PS4 library with 11 visible game titles.
Several games on screen (Ghost of Tsushima, Mortal Kombat 11, Red Dead Redemption 2) show padlock icons.
One game tile is labeled 'EA SPORTS FC 26', which is a non-existent title as of current release cycles.

claims.evidence: Requires a photo of the System Information screen to confirm firmware version (e.g., 9.00 or lower).
photo 1 shows the original PS4 chassis design.
photo 1 shows the official Uncharted 4 Limited Edition branding.
photo 0 shows only 11 games, most of which are locked; 'of your choice' implies a jailbreak service not yet proven.

risks.proof: Photo of Settings > System > System Information showing software version 9.00 or lower.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard updated console with no jailbreak capability.

risks.risk: Digital games are locked or tied to an account that will be removed.
risks.proof: Video showing the games launching and playing without an internet connection.

risks.risk: The boxed controller is a third-party clone rather than original Sony hardware.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the model sticker on the back of the controller.

risks.risk: Optical disc drive may be faulty.
risks.proof: Video of the console successfully reading a physical game disc.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a non-functional disc drive.

proof_requests: Photo of the System Information screen showing the System Software version.
Video of the console booting up and launching one of the listed games.
Photo of the back of the controller to verify authenticity.
Video demonstrating the disc drive accepting and reading a disc.
response.reason: The console is a clearly identifiable Limited Edition PS4. While the software claims and game library are unverified and show signs of being locked or modded (e.g., 'FC26'), the hardware can be priced at its base value for this specific model.
